scripts.build: npm run build:offline && npm run build:daemon -w @earendil-works/pi-env
scripts.build:offline: npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-telemetry && npm run build -w @earendil-works/chord && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-tui && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-codemode && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-mcp && npm run build:offline -w @earendil-works/pi-ai && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-durable && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-env && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-agent-core && npm run build -w @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
scripts.check: node scripts/biome-check.mjs && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/coding-agent/tsconfig.examples.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/evals/tsconfig.json && npm run check:entry-graphs && npm run check:browser-smoke && npm run check:daemon && npm --prefix quality run check
scripts.check:daemon: cd packages/env/daemon && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:fork && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
